notice: AAA-quality is a production target, not a certification or a percentage inferred from task counts. Software implementation, browser validation, publication, player approval and physical hardware acceptance are separate. Local board edits never publish the game.

tasks.title: Playable floating-city expedition
tasks.acceptance: Complete three relays and return via connected foot or rail routes.
tasks.evidence: PR35: 23 model/boundary tests and 39 native browser checks; v0.1.0 published.
tasks.next: Preserve the playable loop while adding devices.

tasks.title: Private narrative / public engine boundary
tasks.acceptance: No private repository, manuscript, privileged key or hidden narrative loader in the public build.
tasks.evidence: PUBLIC_BUILD.md and local-import tests.
tasks.next: Review the allowlisted release files at every publication.

tasks.title: Action-based gamepad input
tasks.acceptance: Analog sticks, radial deadzone, rising-edge actions, neutral reconnect and safe disconnected pause.
tasks.evidence: PR37, Actions 34061735693: real HTTP/WebGL application with explicitly emulated device APIs; no physical device certification.
tasks.next: Physical Xbox QA in I03, then remapping and accessibility.

tasks.title: Xbox menus and gameplay bindings
tasks.acceptance: Start without mouse; navigate dialogs, move/look, hook/reverse/release, fire/reload/pulse; settings persist.
tasks.evidence: PR37, Actions 34061735693: real HTTP/WebGL application with explicitly emulated device APIs; no physical device certification.
tasks.next: Physical Xbox QA in I03, then remapping and accessibility.

tasks.title: Physical Xbox USB and Bluetooth QA
tasks.acceptance: Real Xbox pad on Windows Chrome/Edge: deadzone, reconnect, held buttons, save/resume and full mission.
tasks.evidence: No physical-controller evidence yet.
tasks.next: Record device, connection type, browser and findings.

tasks.title: Remapping and accessibility profiles
tasks.acceptance: Remappable actions, conflict detection, defaults reset and persisted profiles; keyboard remains usable.
tasks.evidence: v0.6 introduced safe binding swaps and stored comfort settings. v0.8 labels match the revised combat layout.
tasks.next: Run the physical Xbox USB and Bluetooth matrix; retain fixed A/B/Menu navigation.

tasks.title: Immersive session and tracked rig
tasks.acceptance: Feature detect immersive-vr; enter on click; local-floor; stereo animation loop; safe denial and exit.
tasks.evidence: PR37, Actions 34061735693: real HTTP/WebGL application with explicitly emulated device APIs; no physical device certification.
tasks.next: Physical Quest 3 verification and performance profiling in X04/X05.

tasks.title: Quest controller movement and aiming
tasks.acceptance: Handed input, independent right-hand aim, left-stick motion, 30-degree snap turn, rail camera never forces head yaw.
tasks.evidence: PR37, Actions 34061735693: real HTTP/WebGL application with explicitly emulated device APIs; no physical device certification.
tasks.next: Physical Quest 3 verification and performance profiling in X04/X05.

tasks.title: In-headset HUD and menus
tasks.acceptance: Health/ammo/objective panel, pause/atlas/archive panels, controller selection and Exit VR without removing headset.
tasks.evidence: PR37, Actions 34061735693: real HTTP/WebGL application with explicitly emulated device APIs; no physical device certification.
tasks.next: Physical Quest 3 verification and performance profiling in X04/X05.

tasks.title: Physical Quest 3 acceptance
tasks.acceptance: Meta Quest Browser: two eyes, controller alignment, floor height, snap turn, menus, rails, suspension/re-entry; no sickness/comfort promise.
tasks.evidence: No physical Quest 3 run yet.
tasks.next: Collect headset browser version and full-session feedback.

tasks.title: Frame-time and rendering budget
tasks.acceptance: Measure sustained CPU/GPU frame times and memory on Quest 3, choose target refresh budget from measurements.
tasks.evidence: XR disables shadows and uses reduced framebuffer scale; no measured target yet.
tasks.next: Profile before adding more scene detail.

tasks.title: Comfort and room-scale calibration
tasks.acceptance: Seated height, handed locomotion, snap/smooth choice, comfort vignette and robust recenter/reference-reset handling.
tasks.evidence: Initial local-floor, snap turn and collision-limited room displacement implemented; full calibration is not.
tasks.next: Tune with physical testing, not desktop assumptions.

tasks.title: Two-hand climb and ledge acquisition
tasks.acceptance: Grip actual hand contacts, pull body with collision, transfer hands, release momentum and recover missed grabs.
tasks.evidence: Not implemented.
tasks.next: Build one climb wall in a mechanics yard.

tasks.title: Gliding from a rail or ledge
tasks.acceptance: Explicit deploy/cancel, carried release momentum, controllable descent, safe landing and comfort controls.
tasks.evidence: Foldwing steering and charge remain; v0.8 restores B as fold/drop while airborne or climbing.
tasks.next: Physical headset comfort and player route quality remain unverified.

tasks.title: Climb / rail / glide state transitions
tasks.acceptance: Continuous velocity between modes; no teleports or phantom grabs; recovery reachable after an intentional miss.
tasks.evidence: Design goal, not a finished traversal system.
tasks.next: Author and replay complete linked routes.

tasks.title: Readable branching rails and reward flow
tasks.acceptance: Fast/high/rich alternatives, deliberate backward exploration, visible receiver, repeatable compatible arrival states.
tasks.evidence: 15 actual rail routes are present. v0.7 tuning has 48 m/s cruise and 96 m/s boost with arrival slowdown.
tasks.next: Test sightline readability and transfers at real speed on target hardware.

tasks.title: Embodied reload and two-hand stabilization
tasks.acceptance: Tracked weapon alignment, magazine interaction, recoil, occlusion and left-handed options.
tasks.evidence: Ray aiming/button reload prototype only.
tasks.next: Keep current button reload as accessible fallback.

tasks.title: Distinct enemies and rail combat
tasks.acceptance: Readable threats, varied movement/attack patterns, fair cover and shooting while traversing.
tasks.evidence: v0.7 has humanoid arena encounters. v0.8 fixes missing arena home/patrol initialization and adds all-three-arena simulation checks.
tasks.next: Review combat fairness, readable silhouettes, cover and ammunition balance with a player.

tasks.title: Temporary tactical cover
tasks.acceptance: Constrained placement, costs, collision and no trapped player or unreachable route.
tasks.evidence: Authored cover rifts have timed collision and occupied-placement rejection; v0.8 visibly distinguishes dormant and active state.
tasks.next: Test every rift beside doors, rail arrivals and player/enemy collision.

tasks.title: Interiors, puzzles and exploration rewards
tasks.acceptance: Playable interior routes, puzzle state saves and rewards worth detouring for.
tasks.evidence: v0.5/v0.6 source contains 12 districts, five enterable rooms, rooftop ladders, puzzles and 13 side adventures. This is not a completed campaign.
tasks.next: Finish and playtest one authored interior-to-rooftop exploration loop.

tasks.title: Original visual and audio production
tasks.acceptance: Coherent architecture, readable surfaces, original audio and performance-budgeted assets.
tasks.evidence: Licensed Quay assets and original procedural audio are in the source. v0.8 adds textured combat cover, visible Tavi and tactical art. Full asset production remains unfinished.
tasks.next: Use P01-P05 acceptance gates instead of treating a material pass as finished AAA art.

tasks.title: Shared 3D world and rail editor
tasks.acceptance: Editable curves, anchors and geometry; validate reachability/clearance; save/export and exact playtest return.
tasks.evidence: Paper Delivery has a separate editor; not silently inherited by Aether Reach.
tasks.next: Define a world format before UI expansion.

tasks.title: Cloud levels and accounts
tasks.acceptance: Authenticated ownership, reviewed database policies, moderation and no client-only paid entitlements.
tasks.evidence: Local checkpoints only; no new cloud integration.
tasks.next: Separate security design and explicit service authorization.

tasks.title: Multiplayer authority and replication
tasks.acceptance: Server-owned simulation, anti-cheat boundaries, interpolation, latency tests and stable room ownership.
tasks.evidence: Single-player currently.
tasks.next: Design authoritative rooms and two-client traversal before competitive game modes. No local bot will be labeled a remote player.

tasks.title: Public Kanban / workbook planning
tasks.acceptance: Searchable tasks, explicit dependencies and gates, local editable statuses, portable export, matching workbook.
tasks.evidence: roadmap.json and planning/AAA-ROADMAP.md are the current committed plan. The eight-sheet v0.3 XLSX remains an explicitly archived snapshot.
tasks.next: Update evidence at each release and keep publication distinct from player acceptance.

tasks.title: Controller/XR preview publication
tasks.acceptance: Pass model, keyboard/touch regression, browser pad and XR-lifecycle tests; byte-verify deployed public files.
tasks.evidence: PR37 acceptance: 38 Node tests and 70 native/device-emulated browser checks, runs 34061735693 and 34061735714.
tasks.next: Read the published-file hash receipt in PR37 for deployment status. Physical hardware gates remain separate.

tasks.title: Four-weapon arsenal and sniper optic
tasks.acceptance: Mechanical differences in cadence, spread, magazine, range and recoil; actual 4x desktop field-of-view optic, not a crosshair picture.
tasks.evidence: v0.8 uses one desktop optic mask and correct tangent-based projection for 4x/8x; no tracked XR magnification claim.
tasks.next: Verify scope framing, recoil and hit feedback with real Xbox and mouse input.

tasks.title: Earned-credit buy and upgrade economy
tasks.acceptance: Three world kiosks, meaningful starter loadout choice, per-weapon damage/reload tiers, shield upgrade; insufficient funds rejected. No real-money purchases.
tasks.evidence: Model purchases, caps, ammunition and save round trips pass. Native buy-upgrade-continue acceptance is tracked in PR39.
tasks.next: Verify keyboard/controller shop navigation and prevent double rewards or free refill exploits.

tasks.title: Exploration caches and enemy salvage
tasks.acceptance: Physical once-only crates and defeated-enemy drops; pickups supply credits/ammunition and selected unlocks; saves cannot repay an already collected crate.
tasks.evidence: Sanitized legacy-compatible kit extension and once-only reward tests pass. Native collection acceptance is tracked in PR39.
tasks.next: Tune rewards so exploring a longer route competes with rushing the objectives.

tasks.title: Free-look aimed jump-and-catch transfers
tasks.acceptance: Default independent sight while riding; two new adjacent detours, visible eligible rail target, physical release and a second catch action in range.
tasks.evidence: Four directions at five carried-state timings, plus 21 recorded-direction Gale release/delay fixtures and a bounded deliberate-input buffer. Native acceptance is tracked in PR39.
tasks.next: Review the receiving line and tolerance while moving; never substitute an instant scene teleport.

tasks.title: Distinct district and enemy silhouettes
tasks.acceptance: Original bazaar stalls, glass roof, industrial gantry/chimneys, solar arrays/beacon; scout rotors, armored heavy and sentry wind-up are visibly different.
tasks.evidence: Native render review identified and corrected blank sign lettering, the stretched rail HUD and phone-control overlap. Final visual acceptance is recorded in PR39.
tasks.next: Check visual readability, weapon framing, clutter and mobile HUD overlap.

tasks.title: Encounter balance and player feedback
tasks.acceptance: Replay the whole objective loop with varied loadouts; compare risk, ammunition demand, reward rate and alternate paths; retain the accessible foot route.
tasks.evidence: Not player-reviewed. Automated passage does not certify enjoyable combat.
tasks.next: Record user feedback and one small repeatable encounter per iteration.

tasks.title: Actual two-client rooms and replicated movement
tasks.acceptance: Two separate browser clients see distinct players, room join/leave, server-owned clock/state and tested latency recovery; no simulated lobby claims.
tasks.evidence: Not implemented. Current public demo is single-player.
tasks.next: Choose and authorize a backend explicitly; implement a minimal two-client movement slice.

tasks.title: Shared loot, buy authority and combat rules
tasks.acceptance: Server validates pickup ownership, currency, shot cadence, ammo and damage; duplicate claims and reconnect replay are rejected.
tasks.evidence: Not implemented. Local single-player saves are not secure multiplayer accounts.
tasks.next: Add authority tests before drops or shops are shared between players.

tasks.title: Magnified tracked weapon optic
tasks.acceptance: Render a real weapon-mounted magnified view within headset frame budget; do not zoom the whole tracked head/eye projection.
tasks.evidence: Desktop scope exists; the XR precision ray does not have a magnified optic.
tasks.next: Measure a render-target optic on real Quest 3 with independent head motion and readable lens.

tasks.title: Durable source snapshots and restore verification
tasks.acceptance: Every versioned release has a tagged public source archive, SHA-256 file manifest and a clean extraction test. Preserve prior releases; never include private source or browser player saves.
tasks.evidence: tools/backup.py and release-backups workflow; publication still subject to runtime checks.
tasks.next: Verify the release assets after deployment. An independent off-site mirror remains outside this GitHub-only backup.

tasks.title: Dual-hand elemental powers and surface tactics
tasks.acceptance: Current electrifies authored water; Cinder ignites oil; gun ammunition and power energy stay separate. Shared sight and collision rules prevent hits through buildings.
tasks.evidence: PR69: model synergies plus ordinary-input Current/gun and Cinder/oil browser scenarios. See final workflow receipts, not this status alone.
tasks.next: Inspect readable feedback and collect player balance feedback.

tasks.title: Local security routing and a friendly turret
tasks.acceptance: A real 3x3 connected-port puzzle changes the Atrium defender. Fourteen shots help but cannot win unattended. All interactions remain entirely inside the game.
tasks.evidence: PR69: connectivity, proximity and finite turret budget tests; native puzzle playthrough.
tasks.next: Make later security choices affect routes and encounter preparation.

tasks.title: Optional Atrium recovery defense
tasks.acceptance: Defend 180 collector hull through three waves and a 48-second minimum. Failure, retreat and safe reload are real; first success grants 180 credits once.
tasks.evidence: PR69: positive and negative model outcomes; native recovery and one-time-reward acceptance required before publication.
tasks.next: Compare active builds and record player difficulty feedback; avoid a passive turret victory.

tasks.title: Enemy surveys and passive build choices
tasks.acceptance: One recorded survey per living visible class grants a 10% gun bonus; unlock one equipped Insulator, Capacitor, Catalyst or Engineer. No repeated-scan farming.
tasks.evidence: PR69: model numeric modifiers, persistence and ordinary-input survey/loadout checks.
tasks.next: Keep passive choices legible and validate all new menus on physical controllers/headsets.

tasks.title: Telekinetic debris and projectile redirection
tasks.acceptance: Acquire visible debris or an eligible projectile, hold and redirect with bounded velocity and collision; independent hands and safe cancellation.
tasks.evidence: Not implemented.
tasks.next: Prototype one throwable prop and one redirectable projectile with deterministic collision tests.

tasks.title: Player-placed traps and constrained defenses
tasks.acceptance: Place a limited trap or defender on valid surfaces with clear costs, ownership, collision, expiry and a readable trigger range.
tasks.evidence: v0.7 charged traps use energy and bounded placement; v0.8 renders active trap and dropped-weapon pools.
tasks.next: Test legibility, costs, trigger range and accessibility in longer encounters.

tasks.title: A prepared boss-style confrontation
tasks.acceptance: A new large enemy has telegraphed phases, discoverable weaknesses and resource choices. Win through learned tactics rather than only greater health.
tasks.evidence: Not implemented; the current recovery ends with one heavier patrol.
tasks.next: Build a single encounter with multiple viable weapon/power builds and recovery paths.

tasks.title: Deeper research and multiple build slots
tasks.acceptance: Distinct research objectives and mutually meaningful slots; explicit respec and progression costs; retain accessible defaults and versioned saves.
tasks.evidence: Current survey records classes and one passive. No research photographs or expanded slot system yet.
tasks.next: Review the first passive balance before expanding combinations.

tasks.title: Foundry Finish tactical art
tasks.acceptance: Cover meshes match collision bounds; Tavi, traps, drops, arena consoles and active rifts are visible without per-frame allocation.
tasks.evidence: v0.8 source ffa9665 passed the Foundry HTTP/WebGL review with visible Tavi, traps, cover and real sniper optics. PR #116 publication matched 78 files.
tasks.next: Continue visual and performance review across the entire district, including new Blackout props.

tasks.title: Arena runtime integrity
tasks.acceptance: Each of the three arenas runs patrol, target acquisition and shooting without undefined home or patrol state.
tasks.evidence: tests/foundry.test.mjs replays all three for 12 simulated seconds.
tasks.next: Extend to two-wave completion, interruptions and varied real loadouts.

tasks.title: One finished district vertical slice
tasks.acceptance: One coherent 20-30 minute route combines street combat, interior exploration, rooftop travel, rewards and a clear ending.
tasks.evidence: v0.9 implements a connected Bellwether street-interior-rooftop-return adventure with saved stages. Mission duration, pacing and player approval are not certified.
tasks.next: Play the complete Blackout adventure and record timing, difficulty, wayfinding and repetitive sections. Gate G1 remains open until player review.

tasks.title: Authored character and weapon animation
tasks.acceptance: Original humanoid mesh, articulated hands, reload/aim/melee animation and locomotion transitions hold up at gameplay distance.
tasks.evidence: Current companion and patrols are procedural articulated geometry, not final character assets.
tasks.next: Produce one licensed or original rigged enemy and one complete weapon-hand set.

tasks.title: Architectural materials and lighting
tasks.acceptance: Consistent scale, trim/material library, wear, foliage, interior lighting and readable cover silhouettes across the slice.
tasks.evidence: v0.8 only finishes a bounded combat kit; city-wide art is incomplete.
tasks.next: Review screenshot comparisons at real play views, not only staged cameras.

tasks.title: Music, effects and mix acceptance
tasks.acceptance: One music transport, independent effects/music/ambience levels, bounded simultaneous cues and clear critical warnings at low volume.
tasks.evidence: Procedural score and independent buses exist; subjective listening and long-session mix are not certified.
tasks.next: Listen on speakers and headphones; log masking, fatigue and critical-cue audibility.

tasks.title: Content expansion after slice approval
tasks.acceptance: Expand approved encounter/interior/route templates into a coherent campaign without repeated filler or unfinished placeholder districts.
tasks.evidence: No campaign-completion claim. Private narrative stays outside this public repository.
tasks.next: Define district-by-district content acceptance and asset ownership.

tasks.title: Desktop frame-time and memory budget
tasks.acceptance: Proposed desktop target: sustained 60 fps at 1080p on an explicitly recorded baseline device; record p95/p99 frame time, memory and 30-minute soak results.
tasks.evidence: No physical desktop GPU measurements yet. Software Chromium timing is not GPU certification.
tasks.next: Select the baseline hardware and settings, then record measured budgets.

tasks.title: Accessibility and long-session controller acceptance
tasks.acceptance: All gameplay dialogs close with B; remapping, text legibility, reduced motion, flash intensity and audio cues pass a real full-session review.
tasks.evidence: Software tests are narrower than long-session physical-controller acceptance.
tasks.next: Run a controller-only expedition with USB and Bluetooth; record every mouse dependency.

tasks.title: Save migration and release recovery
tasks.acceptance: Old checkpoints, purchased equipment and rewards survive updates; corrupt data recovers safely; rollback points are retained.
tasks.evidence: Existing version-1 save validation remains; new visual code does not write saves.
tasks.next: Keep explicit old-version save fixtures and a release restore drill.

tasks.title: Campaign alpha, beta and release candidate gates
tasks.acceptance: Alpha completes content; beta fixes blocking/major defects; a release candidate passes regression, soak, accessibility and public-file hash verification.
tasks.evidence: No alpha, beta or AAA-quality acceptance yet.
tasks.next: Maintain a defect severity register and require evidence before advancing.

tasks.title: Verified publication of each upgrade
tasks.acceptance: Commit intended game files, run regression/browser checks, merge without touching unrelated games, then verify live bytes against that commit.
tasks.evidence: v0.8 production source 878fc4923226c0fce2b5e7d90042bc2f1cbafc06: Pages succeeded and publication run 34702682332 matched 78 files. v0.9 must pass the same post-merge verification.
tasks.next: Record the actual v0.9 merge and live-file receipt before claiming publication.

tasks.title: Bellwether street-interior-rooftop adventure
tasks.acceptance: Complete both combat sites, operate independent Arcade dials, use a continuous roof route, hold the receiver, return for a once-only reward, and save/resume without lost progress or extra enemies.
tasks.evidence: BELLWETHER-BLACKOUT.md; bellwether model/scene modules; tests/bellwether.test.mjs and the full controller browser journey. Test execution and player acceptance remain separately recorded.
tasks.next: Inspect the release browser evidence, then obtain player feedback on this first connected district mission.

milestones.title: Reliable playable foundation
milestones.exit: No launch or arena crashes; working saves and controller interfaces.

milestones.title: Approved polished vertical slice
milestones.exit: A player-approved complete district loop, not just individually passing features.

milestones.title: Production-quality assets
milestones.exit: Original/cleared assets and coherent characters, architecture, animation and lighting.

milestones.title: Campaign content complete
milestones.exit: Distinct districts, interiors, objectives and endings accepted as a complete campaign.

milestones.title: Performance and accessibility
milestones.exit: Recorded physical-device budgets and full controller/accessibility acceptance.

milestones.title: Release candidate and deployment
milestones.exit: No known blocking defects; tested restore and matching live-file hashes.

milestones.title: Separate optional platform gates
milestones.exit: Quest and multiplayer require their own measured hardware/server work. Desktop release does not imply either.
